query: Find columns that look like PII but have no tags
expected_behavior: Searches by fieldPaths for each sensitive token rather than fetching every dataset
Filters to columns whose tag and glossary term lists are both empty
Matches on separator-split tokens so emailer_config is not reported for the email token
Presents results as suspected and unclassified, never asserting the column contains PII
Includes downstream consumer counts to rank which columns matter most
